Try itBuild the launch command

Set on the command line as name:=value. All optional; click a value or type a number to build the command. try it

ArgumentWhat it doesPick
guiDefault true; false runs Gazebo without a window, for a slow computer.
worldDefault patrol; also patrol_doors_swapped and empty.
rvizDefault false; true also opens RViz.
x, y, yawDefault 0.0; the robot's start pose, in meters and radians.
ros2 launch gp2_bringup gp2_sim.launch.py \
  gui:=false rviz:=true
